description:
## Summary

Agent sessions run in containers built from this image; Radicle-native Groundwork requires that a session can operate a Radicle working copy and the native `rad` command surface. The image must carry the Radicle toolchain the same way it carries git and the runa binaries today.

Part of: tesserine/groundwork#538 (execution-boundary enablement).

## Scope

- Image content (Dockerfile / build)
- Image documentation and CHANGELOG

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A session in the built image can run `rad` (1.9.x line) and fetch/push over the Radicle remote (the remote helper resolves on PATH).
- [ ] The toolchain version is pinned and verifiable per the image's existing dependency conventions; image build and the existing runner-contract checks stay green.
- [ ] No identity or credential material is baked into the image — identity creation happens inside the session boundary at runtime (the runner's concern, not the image's).
- [ ] README and CHANGELOG record the new session capability and its version policy.

## Contract inputs

- **Behavior:** a container from the built image demonstrates the `rad` surface without network-independent failures.
- **Documentation:** the image README is where a deployer first learns what sessions can do — it names the Radicle capability.
- **Code quality:** match the image's existing pinning/verification idiom; no ad-hoc install path.

## Dependencies

Depends on: tesserine/commons#108 (implementation-arc gate). Kin: the agentd Radicle-session unit (consumes this), the babbie-ops node unit (network topology sessions reach).
title: feat(image): the session image carries the Radicle toolchain
